## How to update your progress

1. Open `index.html` in your browser (double-click the file)
2. Update statuses and notes for each action
3. Click **"Save snapshot as HTML"** at the bottom of the page
4. Rename the downloaded file to `index.html`
5. Commit and push it to this repo — the live URL updates automatically within ~60 seconds

```bash
git add index.html
git commit -m "Update IDP progress - April 2026"
git push
```

Rawan can always see the latest version at the live URL above — no login needed.
